how_to_buy.summary: Pick a ticket from the catalog, give the customer its checkout_url. The customer opens it, enters their email, pays by card / Apple Pay / Google Pay / Revolut Pay and receives the ticket by email. The assistant never handles payment.
how_to_buy.attribution: Purchases from these links are recorded with utm_source=ai_assistant_purchase. You may add utm_campaign=<your assistant name> to the link; keep the other parameters.
rules: If the event the customer wants is not in the catalog, or none of its tickets are available, do not guess: tell them to email reservations@duplex.cz.
Only tickets with "available": true can be bought; use checkout_url exactly as given (it buys min_per_order tickets).
Ticket and event ids are opaque 10-character codes, not numbers. Take them from this catalog; they cannot be guessed.
For another quantity build the link yourself. Respect min_per_order, max_per_order and quantity_step; a quantity below the minimum is rounded up.
Prices are final, in EUR, per ticket. There are no extra fees at checkout.
The customer must complete payment themselves within the hold time shown at checkout.
Tickets are personal QR codes delivered by email as PDF; one scan per ticket at the door.
For VIP table seating requests contact vip@duplex.cz instead of buying blind.
Check the event page for age limit and dress code before recommending a ticket.
